item.title: Lean for the Working Mathematician
item.author: harisankar.b@niser.ac.in (Harisankar B)
item.description: We ran an introductory Lean workshop at NISER, the same week a Lean proof of the Riemann Hypothesis was released. Here is what we covered, from Curry–Howard to tactics, and a longer answer to the best question of the day: who checks the checker?
